product.sentenceEn: Unlike many food waste projects that have sprung up in recent years, the idea is not simply to redistribute waste food, but to provide a high-quality product .

product.sentenceEn: We assume that if we offer our customers more choices, then they'll be more likely to buy our products .
product.translationZh: 我们认为，如果给客户提供更多选择，他们就更有可能购买我们的产品。

product.sentenceEn: Once sourced, Elysia uses waste products to create "simple, natural, straightforward" meals and snacks.
product.translationZh: 一旦完成原料采购，Elysia便利用废弃食材制作出"简单、天然、纯粹"的餐食和零食。

product.sentenceEn: What can we conclude about Impossible Foods' products from Joan Solsman's remark?

participant.sentenceEn: Experiments showed that participants were less likely to choose someone who signals their wealth or status to join a group seeking cooperative members.

participant.sentenceEn: But participants were more likely to choose that person when they're looking for a competitive team member.

participant.sentenceEn: The findings showed that, despite missing half of this critical organ, participants could function well.

participant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

participant.sentenceEn: After the intervention, participants associated healthy eating with autonomy and social justice.
participant.translationZh: 干预结束后，参与者将健康饮食与自主权及社会正义联系在了一起。

process.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

process.sentenceEn: In the process , we may fail to attend to ourselves in a way that would move us toward deeper intimacy, fulfillment, and meaning.
process.translationZh: 在这个过程中，我们可能会忽视自我关怀，而这种关怀本可以引导我们走向更深层次的亲密关系、成就感和人生意义。
process.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

process.sentenceEn: Another study involved people who could smell, despite missing the region in the brain that processes information about smells.

process.sentenceEn: There simply isn't a one-size-fits-all process .
process.translationZh: 根本就没有一种放之四海而皆准的流程。

process.sentenceEn: Cloning is too complicated a process .

professor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

professor.sentenceEn: "There are a lot of nutrients contained in the parts of the fruits, such as in apple skins, that are excluded when you juice them," says Heather Ferris, a professor of medicine.
professor.translationZh: 医学教授希瑟·费里斯说：“水果的许多营养成分，比如苹果皮中的营养，在榨汁时都会被去除。”

professor.sentenceEn: One way we can improve the effects of fruit juice on our health is making sure we select ripe fruit to retain as much of its goodness as possible, according to Roger Clemens, professor of pharmaceutical(药物的) sciences at the University of Southern California.
professor.translationZh: 南加州大学药物科学教授罗杰·克莱门斯表示，要提高果汁对健康的益处，方法之一是确保选择成熟的水果，以保留尽可能多的营养成分。

professor.sentenceEn: What can the new findings do according to Professor Sillero?
professor.translationZh: 根据西莱罗教授的说法，这些新发现能起到什么作用？

positive.sentenceEn: However, if you work on sticking to those small positive habits one day at a time, it becomes easier to stay strong and achieve that delayed reward.
positive.translationZh: 然而，如果你坚持每天培养这些微小的积极习惯，就会更容易保持毅力并最终获得那份延迟的回报。

positive.sentenceEn: They enhanced the positive image of the school.

power.sentenceEn: There would be no mystery in this if Keynes had been wrong about the power of technology to increase the economy's productivity, which he thought would lead to a standard of living "between four and eight times as high as it is today."

power.sentenceEn: Why do we allow what others think of us to have so much power over how we feel about ourselves?

possibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

possibility.sentenceEn: A third possibility proves more convincing for Friedman.
possibility.translationZh: 对弗里德曼而言，第三种可能性更具说服力。

possibility.translationZh: 远程教育可能成为常态的主要原因是什么？

priority.sentenceEn: The reality is, nobody is too busy—it's just about priorities .
priority.translationZh: 事实上，没有人会忙到抽不出时间——关键在于优先级的安排。
priority.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

priority.sentenceEn: Fourth, they considered their alternatives: is there anything at work that could be changed to accommodate these new priorities ?
priority.translationZh: 第四，他们考虑了自己的备选方案：工作中是否有什么可以改变的地方，以适应这些新的优先事项？

priority.sentenceEn: Sustainable fuels are the top priority to enable greener space travel.
priority.translationZh: 可持续燃料是实现更环保太空旅行的首要任务。
priority.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

priority.sentenceEn: Focus on the top spots on your priority list, and ensure a potential employer at least checks those boxes.
priority.translationZh: 将重点放在你优先级列表中的前几项上，并确保潜在雇主至少满足这些要求。

priority.sentenceEn: When making decisions, we give priority to our current frame of mind without thinking much of the consequences.
priority.translationZh: 做决策时，我们往往优先考虑当下的心情，而很少思考后果。

priority.sentenceEn: They will be given hiring priority .
priority.translationZh: 他们将获得优先录用权。

political.sentenceEn: Given that sort of mess, can political fights over bike lanes ever end?
political.translationZh: 鉴于这种乱象，关于自行车道的政治纷争会有平息的一天吗？

political.sentenceEn: And then, for the last 10 years, I've worked as a political consultant, advising politicians at the national level about problems in our country.
political.translationZh: 然后，在过去的10年里，我一直担任政治顾问，为国家级别的政治人物就国家问题提供建议。
political.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

political.sentenceEn: "It's very surprising to me," says Sam Chetan-Walsh, a political adviser at Greenpeace and campaigner against ocean plastic.
political.translationZh: 绿色和平组织政治顾问兼反海洋塑料活动家山姆·切坦-沃尔什表示：“这让我非常惊讶。”

political.sentenceEn: While risk-taking can be considered a negative attribute, it's also a characteristic of successful people, including athletes, political leaders and entrepreneurs.
political.translationZh: 虽然冒险可能被视为一种负面特质，但它也是成功人士的共同特征，包括运动员、政治领袖和企业家。
political.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

political.sentenceEn: What do most Americans expect to see soon on America's political stage?
political.translationZh: 大多数美国人期望很快在美国政治舞台上看到什么？

political.sentenceEn: He reviews books on political affairs.
political.translationZh: 他评论政治事务方面的书籍。

parental.sentenceEn: Parental financial support of early adults, said Ken Dychtwald, CEO of Age Wave, is "the new normal".

parental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

parental.sentenceEn: Of those surveyed, 62% of fathers took the maximum amount of time off compared to 93% of mothers, and around three-quarters of workers said their employer was equally supportive of mothers and fathers taking parental leave and over half said leave policies had made workplace culture better.
parental.translationZh: 在接受调查的人中，62%的父亲休满了最长假期，而母亲的这一比例为93%。约四分之三的受访者表示，雇主对母亲和父亲休育儿假给予同等支持，超过一半的人认为休假政策改善了职场文化。

parental.sentenceEn: Since then, there have been a number of legal cases against companies involving paternity leave—including cases against JPMorgan Chase and Estee Lauder—which have helped put pressure on companies to make their parental leave policies gender neutral.
parental.translationZh: 从那以后，出现了多起涉及陪产假的公司诉讼案件——包括针对摩根大通和雅诗兰黛的诉讼——这些案件促使企业面临压力，不得不将其育儿假政策调整为性别中立。

parental.sentenceEn: Thus, they were allowed to take 16 weeks of paid parental leave.
parental.translationZh: 因此，母亲们被允许休16周的带薪育儿假。

parental.sentenceEn: The majority of workers surveyed said parental leave policies had improved workplace culture.
parental.translationZh: 大多数受访员工表示，育儿假政策改善了职场文化。

parental.sentenceEn: About 58% of young adults call parental support the new normal.
parental.translationZh: 约58%的年轻人将父母支持视为新常态。

perceive.sentenceEn: In one survey, 89% of employees perceived companies that sponsored volunteer activities as creating a better working environment, and 75% said volunteering was critical to their well-being.
perceive.translationZh: 在一项调查中，89%的员工认为赞助志愿活动的公司能创造更好的工作环境，75%的员工表示志愿服务对他们的幸福感至关重要。
perceive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第8句

perceive.sentenceEn: Studies report that where you sit in the classroom can impact your ability to learn and the way your teacher perceives you.
perceive.translationZh: 研究表明，在教室中落座的位置会影响你的学习能力以及老师对你的看法。
perceive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

perceive.sentenceEn: But too often we get caught in this place where conflict is perceived to be negative—something we want to avoid so that we can maintain the harmony of our workplace.
perceive.translationZh: 但我们常常陷入这样一种境地：将冲突视为负面的东西——我们想要避免的事情，以便维持工作场所的和谐。
perceive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

perceive.sentenceEn: Yet, very little research has focused on how dogs perceive and socially engage with children.
perceive.translationZh: 然而，关于狗如何感知儿童并与他们进行社交互动的研究却很少。
perceive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

perceive.sentenceEn: They found busy people are perceived to be of high status, and interestingly, these status attributions are heavily influenced by our own beliefs about social mobility.
perceive.translationZh: 他们发现，忙碌的人被认为地位较高，有趣的是，这种地位归因深受我们自身对社会流动性的信念影响。

perceive.sentenceEn: They were perceived differently by some academics.
perceive.translationZh: 一些学者对它们有不同的看法。

peer.sentenceEn: They suspected older, more mature students obtained more self-confidence than their peers because they achieved better grades.
peer.translationZh: 他们猜测，年龄较大、更为成熟的学生比同龄人拥有更强的自信心，这是因为他们取得了更好的成绩。
peer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

peer.sentenceEn: It can be harder for students to create study groups and form relationships with their peers .
peer.translationZh: 学生们更难组建学习小组，也难以与同龄人建立关系。
peer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

peer.sentenceEn: Physically attending school has hidden benefits: getting up every morning, interacting with peers , and building relationships with teachers are essential skills to cultivate in young people.
peer.translationZh: 亲身到校上课有诸多隐性益处：每天早起、与同龄人互动以及与老师建立关系，这些都是年轻人需要培养的基本技能。
peer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

peer.sentenceEn: By sharing knowledge of agriculture and climate with peers in countries most vulnerable to poverty and hunger, scientists can help reduce these problems.
peer.translationZh: 通过与最易受贫困和饥饿影响国家的同行分享农业和气候方面的知识，科学家们可以帮助缓解这些问题。
peer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

peer.sentenceEn: Number words and their written forms transform our quantitative reasoning as they are introduced into our cognitive experience by our parents, peers and school teachers.
peer.translationZh: 数字词汇及其书面形式在被父母、同伴和学校老师引入我们的认知经验后，改变了我们的定量推理能力。

peer.sentenceEn: Their relations with peers were badly strained.
peer.translationZh: 他们与同龄人的关系严重紧张。

portion.sentenceEn: "The best example is five a day, the recommendation to have at least five portions of fruit and vegetables every day. Almost everyone is aware of this, but something like 15% of us achieve it."
portion.translationZh: 最典型的例子是“每日五份”原则——建议每天至少摄入五份水果和蔬菜。几乎每个人都知道这个建议，但只有约15%的人能做到。

portion.sentenceEn: Try to remember that as you are staring at the application for your marriage license and filling out the portion that reads "name after you get married" (or whatever the legalese for that might be).
portion.translationZh: 当你盯着结婚证申请表，填写那个写着“婚后姓名”（或任何类似的法律术语）的部分时，请记住这一点。

portion.sentenceEn: If you care about outside opinions on your name, you should know that a large portion of today's society is annoyed by the hyphenated name.
portion.translationZh: 如果你在意外界对你姓名的看法，你应该知道当今社会有很大一部分人对连字符形式的姓氏感到反感。

portion.sentenceEn: For starters, Americans eat much bigger portions than people in other countries.
portion.translationZh: 首先，美国人的食量比其他国家的人大得多。
portion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

portion.sentenceEn: We get a fairly large portion of calories from fast food and snacks.
portion.translationZh: 我们从快餐和零食中摄取相当大比例的卡路里。

portion.sentenceEn: Oil importers account for a larger portion of the global economy.
portion.translationZh: 石油进口国在全球经济中所占份额更大。

pose.sentenceEn: Consequently, being replaced by a robot or software poses less of a threat to their feeling of self-worth.
pose.translationZh: 因此，被机器人或软件取代对他们的自我价值感威胁较小。

pose.sentenceEn: In one recent case, an international gang used an extremely realistic mask to pose as a French minister, cheating business executives out of millions of pounds.
pose.translationZh: 在最近的一个案例中，一个国际犯罪团伙使用极其逼真的面具伪装成法国部长，骗取了企业高管数百万英镑。

pose.translationZh: 为解决这一问题，美国国务院提出了一个解决方案：在线学习。

pose.translationZh: 在记者和摄影师面前咬奖牌已成为奥运会奖牌得主的常见姿势。
pose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

pose.sentenceEn: The trend for bigger housing thus poses ethical questions.
pose.translationZh: 因此，这种追求更大住房的趋势引发了伦理问题。

pose.sentenceEn: It reduces various health risks posed by meat consumption.
pose.translationZh: 它能降低因肉类消费带来的各种健康风险。

preserve.translationZh: 但新研究表明，"适度的不适和分散"实际上可能有助于保护熊猫种群。

preserve.sentenceEn: The status of the upper classes was threatened; fashion was a tool to preserve it.
preserve.translationZh: 上层阶级的地位受到了威胁；时尚成为他们维系地位的工具。
preserve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

preserve.sentenceEn: Our eyesight may dim and our recall may weaken, but, by comparison, our ability to produce and to comprehend language is well preserved into older adulthood.
preserve.translationZh: 我们的视力可能会衰退，记忆力可能会减弱，但相比之下，我们的语言生成和理解能力在老年时期仍然保持得很好。
preserve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

preserve.sentenceEn: It made every effort to keep the essential capabilities of smartphones, but strip out costs and preserve battery life for people who likely have inadequate access to electricity.
preserve.translationZh: 该公司竭力保留智能手机的核心功能，同时剔除不必要的成本，并延长电池续航时间——这对于那些很可能无法稳定获取电力的用户来说至关重要。
preserve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

preserve.sentenceEn: Hyphenating names allows the bride to preserve her own identity while respecting tradition.
preserve.translationZh: 使用连字符连接姓氏既能让新娘保留自己的身份，又能尊重传统。

preserve.sentenceEn: It is very important to preserve their genetic diversity.
preserve.translationZh: 保护它们的遗传多样性非常重要。

profit.sentenceEn: "The winning team chooses where it wants the profits to go," says Ritman Smith.
profit.translationZh: 里特曼·史密斯说：“获胜团队可以选择利润的去向。”

profit.sentenceEn: But they raise concerns about health rather than profit margins.
profit.translationZh: 但他们关注的是健康问题，而非利润率。

profit.sentenceEn: Owner Guy Wilson says his café aims to build community, rather than profits .
profit.translationZh: 店主盖伊·威尔逊表示，他的咖啡馆旨在建立社区联结，而非追求利润。

profit.sentenceEn: Unless employees are fully compensated, this could become a variant of parasitic(寄生的) capitalism, whereby corporate profits increasingly rely on extracting value from the public—and now personal—realm, rather than on generating new value.
profit.translationZh: 除非员工获得充分补偿，否则这可能演变成一种寄生资本主义的变体——企业利润越来越依赖于从公共领域（如今还包括个人领域）榨取价值，而非创造新价值。
profit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

profit.sentenceEn: Bottled water manufacturers base their arguments against bans of plastic bottles on health concerns rather than on profits .
profit.translationZh: 瓶装水制造商反对塑料瓶禁令的理由是出于健康考虑，而非利润。

profit.sentenceEn: They have been losing customers and profits .
profit.translationZh: 它们一直在流失顾客和利润。

propose.translationZh: 在9180万美元的拟议预算中，最大的支出项仍是教师工资。

propose.translationZh: 州众议员亚当·马修斯是提出该法案的两位议员之一。

propose.sentenceEn: The researchers said there are numerous schools of thought that propose differing psychological methods for strengthening relationships.
propose.translationZh: 研究人员表示，有众多学派提出了不同的心理方法来加强人际关系。

propose.sentenceEn: Government officials proposed to protect the area's endangered wild fish by issuing a fishing ban over the next decade.
propose.translationZh: 政府官员提议在未来十年实施禁渔令，以保护该地区濒危的野生鱼类。

propose.translationZh: Game Academy 旨在通过批判性思维帮助玩家提升游戏技能。

parking.sentenceEn: " Parking here is already a nightmare," one shouted at a protest rally.

parking.sentenceEn: Removing cars and parking spots works.
parking.translationZh: 移除车辆和停车位确实有效。

parking.sentenceEn: She said business fell by at least 40 percent when the city removed nearby parking to put in a bike lane.
parking.translationZh: 她表示，由于城市为了修建自行车道而拆除了附近的停车位，生意额至少下降了40%。

parking.sentenceEn: Five years ago, the city of Queens, New York, announced that it would be putting bike lanes onto a stretch of Skillman Ave — and removing 116 parking spots.
parking.translationZh: 五年前，纽约市皇后区宣布，将在斯基尔曼大道的部分路段增设自行车道，并为此取消 116 个停车位。

parking.sentenceEn: Taking out those parking spots, as they argued at protests and in letters to the city council, would ruin stores and restaurants along Skillman.
parking.translationZh: 正如他们在抗议活动中以及给市议会的信函中所主张的那样，取消这些停车位会毁掉斯基尔曼大街沿线的商店和餐馆。

parking.sentenceEn: Local business owners on Skillman Ave argued that their businesses would be ruined when parking spots were replaced by bike lanes.
parking.translationZh: 斯基尔曼大道上的当地商家认为，如果停车位被自行车道取代，他们的生意将会遭到毁灭性的打击。

penalty.translationZh: 但其他采用相同方法的研究表明，有时功败垂成也并不会带来什么不利影响。

penalty.sentenceEn: Especially for women, there is a clear penalty at work for being overweight or obese.
penalty.translationZh: 尤其对于女性而言，超重或肥胖在工作中会带来明显的负面影响。

penalty.sentenceEn: While the continued gender penalty in the labor market is frustrating, our finding that misperceived weight does not harm workers is more heartening.

penalty.translationZh: 关于死刑的争论焦点是什么？

penalty.translationZh: 他们会因犯下轻微罪行而受到严厉惩罚。

perception.sentenceEn: That's why we feel like we have to appear busy, and there's a real perception that if someone is knee-deep in meetings, emails, and stress, then they're probably a big deal.

property.sentenceEn: Horn said phantom traffic jams are an emergent property of the flow of vehicles down a highway.
property.translationZh: 霍恩表示，幽灵交通拥堵是高速公路上车辆流动的一种涌现特性。

property.sentenceEn: But she does eat yogurt every day, which she said has "an infinite number of positive properties " for the body.
property.translationZh: 不过她每天确实会吃酸奶，她表示酸奶对身体有“无穷无尽的益处”。

property.translationZh: 旧金山已禁止它们进入城市财产和活动场所。

percentage.sentenceEn: The overall trend is hitting Americans of all different levels of educational attainment, although the percentages vary by category.
percentage.translationZh: 这一总体趋势影响着不同受教育程度的美国人，尽管各类的百分比有所不同。
percentage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

percentage.sentenceEn: In 1970, the percentage of women majoring in engineering was less than 1%.
percentage.translationZh: 1970年，主修工程学的女性比例不到1%。
percentage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

percentage.sentenceEn: Similar percentages of men and women said they enjoyed their careers and that it gave them a sense of achievement, while around half of women and 44% of men said it was a key part of their identity.
percentage.translationZh: 在享受职业生涯并从中获得成就感方面，男性和女性的比例相近；而约半数女性和44%的男性表示，职业是他们身份认同的重要组成部分。

percentage.sentenceEn: Campaigners point out that a high percentage of the prison population is left-handed.
percentage.translationZh: 活动人士指出，监狱人口中左撇子的比例很高。
percentage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

percentage.sentenceEn: In a considerable percentage of cases of debt-induced financial stress, credit cards and loans will be a central element.
percentage.translationZh: 在相当一部分由债务引发的经济压力案例中，信用卡和贷款往往是核心因素。
percentage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

percentage.sentenceEn: The percentage of young men who live with their parents has grown due to their decreased pay in recent decades.
percentage.translationZh: 近几十年来，由于收入下降，与父母同住的年轻男性比例有所上升。

perspective.sentenceEn: I believe this fear could be tempered by putting decisions into perspective .
perspective.translationZh: 我相信，通过透彻地审视决策，这种恐惧是可以得到缓解的。
perspective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

perspective.sentenceEn: And if it seems like finding that perfect balance remains difficult to achieve, the experts say that keeping some perspective can help.
perspective.translationZh: 如果找到这种完美平衡似乎仍然难以实现，专家表示，保持一定的洞察力会有所帮助。

perspective.sentenceEn: The business perspective offers a different view: multitasking is understood as the ability to adapt to all types of environment within a company and effectively undertake different activities within a set time frame.
perspective.translationZh: 从商业角度来看则有所不同：多任务处理被理解为能够适应公司内的各种环境，并在规定时间内有效开展不同活动的能力。
perspective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

perspective.sentenceEn: From this different perspective , you can not only be multitasking but this ability can also be taught: something that is easier in fluid organisations, which favour flexibility in their working practices.
perspective.translationZh: 从这个不同的角度来看，人们不仅可以进行多任务处理，而且这种能力也是可以培养的：在灵活的组织中更容易做到这一点，这类组织在工作实践中崇尚灵活性。
perspective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

perspective.sentenceEn: There is an obvious lack of teachers with a multicultural perspective to meet the curriculum challenges in America.
perspective.translationZh: 美国明显缺乏具有多元文化视角的教师来应对课程挑战。

perspective.sentenceEn: Employers differ from employees in their perspectives on diversity.
perspective.translationZh: 雇主和员工在多样性的看法上存在差异。

persuade.sentenceEn: Posting about luxury purchases and expensive vacations online may help you to persuade others and frighten competitors, but it could also signal to potential friends or future employers that you are unlikely to think about the needs of others.
persuade.translationZh: 在网上炫耀奢侈品购买和奢华度假经历，或许能帮你说服他人、震慑竞争对手，但也可能向潜在的朋友或未来的雇主传递出你不太会考虑他人需求的信号。
persuade.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

persuade.sentenceEn: "For now, I think the negative reputation around games means that telling someone you're a determined gamer is more likely to harm your chances of getting a job. But if someone can explain how they've led a team in an online game, for example, they may be able to persuade an employer that this is useful," says Dr Barr.
persuade.translationZh: 巴尔博士表示：“目前，我认为针对游戏的负面评价意味着，告诉别人你是一名资深玩家更有可能损害你的求职机会。但如果有人能够解释他们是如何在网络游戏中领导团队的，他们或许就能说服雇主，证明这项经历是有用的。”

persuade.sentenceEn: Luckily, I managed to persuade her otherwise.
persuade.translationZh: 幸运的是，我成功说服她改变了主意。
persuade.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第3句

persuade.sentenceEn: We persuade and get persuaded every day—we're either convincing or being convinced.
persuade.translationZh: 我们每天都在说服别人，也在被别人说服——不是在说服他人，就是在被他人说服。
persuade.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

persuade.sentenceEn: When are you more likely to succeed in persuading your coworkers?
persuade.translationZh: 什么时候你更有可能成功说服同事？

persuade.sentenceEn: An effective intervention has to be found to persuade teenagers to switch to a healthier lifestyle.
persuade.translationZh: 必须找到一种有效的干预手段，以说服青少年转而采取更健康的生活方式。

possibly.sentenceEn: W: No, actually, I was wondering how you could possibly afford a new phone.
possibly.translationZh: 女：不，其实我是在想你怎么可能买得起新手机。
possibly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

possibly.sentenceEn: It's not as popular as some sports, which means he has better odds of possibly getting an athletic scholarship in the future.
possibly.translationZh: 这项运动不像某些运动那样受欢迎，这意味着他将来获得体育奖学金的几率可能更大。
possibly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

possibly.sentenceEn: This implies that even though ambitious people are more likely to achieve conventional "success," such success means nothing for their health and happiness—and if you don't have health and happiness, what else could possibly matter?
possibly.translationZh: 这意味着，尽管有抱负的人更容易取得传统意义上的"成功"，但这种成功对他们的健康和幸福毫无意义——如果你没有健康和幸福，还有什么可能更重要呢？
possibly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

possibly.sentenceEn: What we have not yet understood is the way the tiny machines in front of us are changing our skeletons, possibly altering not just the way we behave but even the very shape of our bodies.
possibly.translationZh: 我们尚未认识到的是，眼前这些小型设备正在如何改变我们的骨骼，这可能不仅改变我们的行为方式，甚至还会改变我们的身体形态。
possibly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

possibly.sentenceEn: Research is limited, but some studies suggest that people who can master lucid dreaming—that is, the ability to be aware that a nightmare is happening and possibly even control it without waking up—may hold the answer.
possibly.translationZh: 相关研究虽然有限，但一些研究表明，能够掌握清醒梦的人——即能够意识到噩梦正在发生，甚至可能在不醒来的情况下控制噩梦的能力——或许掌握着答案。
possibly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

possibly.sentenceEn: What will the man possibly do on Saturday?
possibly.translationZh: 男士周六可能会做什么？

previously.sentenceEn: New findings suggest that the kinds of complex and strategic self-presentation behaviour we see in adults appear at a much younger age than previously known.
previously.translationZh: 新发现表明，我们在成年人身上看到的那种复杂且具有策略性的自我展示行为，出现的年龄比之前所知要早得多。
previously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

previously.sentenceEn: Previously , the doctors made voice recordings that were then transcribed by secretaries—a process that was costly and likely to cause delays.
previously.translationZh: 以前，医生们会先录制语音，再由秘书进行转录——这一过程既耗费成本，又容易造成延误。

previously.sentenceEn: Previously , the lowest price had been around $40, well out of reach for many people.
previously.translationZh: 此前，最低价格约为40美元，这对许多人来说遥不可及。
previously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

previously.sentenceEn: Researchers have previously found a link between eating more fruits and vegetables, and improved longer term mental health.
previously.translationZh: 研究人员此前已发现，多吃水果和蔬菜与长期改善心理健康之间存在关联。
previously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

previously.sentenceEn: It previously specialized in private charter flights for government officials.
previously.translationZh: 该公司此前专门为政府官员提供私人包机服务。
previously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

previously.sentenceEn: It may be less damaging than previously believed.
previously.translationZh: 它的危害可能没有之前认为的那么大。

puzzle.sentenceEn: Right over here, we have dozens of puzzles for children of all ages.
puzzle.translationZh: 这边，我们有几十种适合各年龄段儿童的拼图。
puzzle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

puzzle.sentenceEn: Do you enjoy unusual puzzle games like Portal, or tower defence games like Defense Grid?
puzzle.translationZh: 你是否喜欢像《传送门》这样不落俗套的谜题游戏，或是像《防御阵型》这样的塔防游戏？

puzzle.sentenceEn: "Most videogames are essentially puzzles to solve," he says.
puzzle.translationZh: 他说：“大多数视频游戏本质上都是待解的谜题。”

puzzle.sentenceEn: Conventional fixes like word puzzles and brain-training apps can contribute to mental durability.
puzzle.translationZh: 像填字游戏和大脑训练应用程序这样的传统方法有助于增强心智耐力。
puzzle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

puzzle.sentenceEn: What does the woman find puzzling ?
puzzle.translationZh: 这位女士觉得什么事情令人困惑？

puzzle.sentenceEn: Wishing to solve puzzles enhances one's reasoning power.
puzzle.translationZh: 喜欢解谜能增强人的推理能力。

partly.sentenceEn: The researchers explain that the possible reason for this may partly have been the lack of the other components found in whole fruit, like fibre.
partly.translationZh: 研究人员解释说，造成这种情况的可能原因部分在于全果中含有的其他成分（如纤维）的缺乏。

partly.sentenceEn: This is partly due to a lack of necessary evidence.
partly.translationZh: 部分原因是缺乏必要的证据。
partly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

partly.sentenceEn: This is partly because of adequate sunlight and partly because technology has become more affordable in the region.
partly.translationZh: 这部分是因为该地区光照充足，部分是因为相关技术在该地区的成本已更为亲民。
partly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

partly.sentenceEn: W: John, your book is getting a lot of attention, partly because you write that most people can retire by 40.
partly.translationZh: 约翰，你的书引起了广泛关注，部分原因是你在书中写道大多数人可以在40岁前退休。
partly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

partly.sentenceEn: One veteran player has applied his gaming skills to his real-world business and owes his success partly to a game company.
partly.translationZh: 一位资深玩家将游戏技巧应用到了现实世界的商业经营中，并将其成功部分归功于一家游戏公司。

partly.sentenceEn: It partly records his own experience.
partly.translationZh: 这在一定程度上记录了他自己的经历。

pearl.sentenceEn: I've read some financial education books, done some online learning, and have spoken to my nearest and dearest for their pearls of financial wisdom.
pearl.translationZh: 我读过一些金融教育书籍，参加过一些在线学习，也向我的至亲好友请教过他们宝贵的财务智慧。
pearl.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

pearl.sentenceEn: The pearl of Allah, which is currently on display in a New York museum only weighs 14 pounds.
pearl.translationZh: 目前在纽约一家博物馆展出的“真主之珠”仅重14磅。
pearl.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

pearl.sentenceEn: That is 5 times smaller than the pearl that the fisherman just handed in.
pearl.translationZh: 这比渔夫刚刚交出的那颗珍珠小了5倍。
pearl.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

pearl.sentenceEn: The unidentified man had fished out a giant pearl from the ocean when his anchor got stuck on the rock while sailing off the coastal island in the Philippines ten years ago.
pearl.translationZh: 这位身份不明的男子十年前在菲律宾沿海岛屿附近航行时，因锚被岩石卡住，从海里捞起了一颗巨大的珍珠。
pearl.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

pearl.sentenceEn: The monstrous pearl measured at one foot wide and 2.2 feet long is going to be verified by local experts and international authorities before hopefully going on display to attract more tourists in the little town.
pearl.translationZh: 这颗巨大的珍珠宽1英尺，长2.2英尺，将先由当地专家和国际权威机构进行鉴定，之后有望展出，以吸引更多游客来到这个小镇。
pearl.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

pearl.sentenceEn: His pearl could be displayed in a museum.
pearl.translationZh: 他的这颗珍珠或将在博物馆展出。

persuasion.sentenceEn: Effective use of persuasion skills will not only help get your coworkers excited about your ideas, it'll also help you motivate them to achieve a common goal.
persuasion.translationZh: 有效运用说服技巧不仅能让同事对你的想法感到兴奋，还能激励他们为实现共同目标而努力。
persuasion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

persuasion.sentenceEn: Therefore, organizations and leaders should adopt powerful persuasion skills to bring about necessary changes.
persuasion.translationZh: 因此，组织和领导者应运用有力的说服技巧来推动必要的变革。
persuasion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

persuasion.sentenceEn: For some of us, persuasion is an instinctive quality and the power of influencing comes naturally.
persuasion.translationZh: 对我们中的一些人来说，说服力是一种本能特质，影响他人的能力与生俱来。
persuasion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

persuasion.sentenceEn: Besides, teamwork and leadership rely heavily on the power of persuasion to get things done.
persuasion.translationZh: 此外，团队合作和领导力在很大程度上依赖说服力来推动工作完成。
persuasion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

persuasion.sentenceEn: Employers place a great value on employees with persuasion skills because they can impact several aspects of job performance.
persuasion.translationZh: 雇主非常重视具备说服能力的员工，因为他们能影响工作表现的多个方面。
persuasion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

persuasion.sentenceEn: Why are persuasion skills greatly valued in the workplace?
persuasion.translationZh: 为什么说服技巧在工作场合受到高度重视？

pursuit.sentenceEn: Digital entrepreneur and business consultant Mia Bennett says: "In more traditional settings, gaming is still imagined to be the pursuit of teenage boys — a waste of time."
pursuit.translationZh: 数字企业家兼商业顾问米娅·贝内特（Mia Bennett）表示：“在传统观念中，人们仍然认为电子游戏是青少年的消遣——纯粹是在浪费时间。”

pursuit.sentenceEn: New York University's Lechner agrees that finding that balance is an ongoing pursuit .
pursuit.translationZh: 纽约大学的莱希纳也认为，找到这种平衡是一个持续的过程。

pursuit.sentenceEn: Those were the words uttered by pioneering British scientist Rosalind Franklin, who firmly believed that the pursuit of science should be accessible to all.
pursuit.translationZh: 这是英国开创性科学家罗莎琳德·富兰克林的言论，她坚信科学探索应该是所有人都能接触的。
pursuit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

pursuit.sentenceEn: Older people who watch more television are also less likely to undertake activities known to preserve mental functioning such as reading, or interactive screen-based pursuits such as using the Internet or playing video games.
pursuit.translationZh: 看电视较多的老年人也不太可能从事已知有助于保持心智功能的活动，如阅读，或基于屏幕的互动性消遣活动，如使用互联网或玩电子游戏。
pursuit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

pursuit.sentenceEn: By this, I'm not advocating that you should give up your pursuit of having a fulfilling career and a thriving personal life, and I'm definitely not saying that you have to give up one to have the other.
pursuit.translationZh: 我这么说，并不是主张你应该放弃追求有成就感的事业和充实的个人生活，也绝不是说你必须牺牲一个才能拥有另一个。
pursuit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

pursuit.sentenceEn: The pursuit of a fulfilling career involves personal sacrifice.
pursuit.translationZh: 追求有成就感的事业需要个人付出牺牲。

phenomenon.sentenceEn: This phenomenon has been observed several times but rarely studied properly.
phenomenon.translationZh: 这种现象已被观察到多次，但很少得到恰当的研究。
phenomenon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

phenomenon.sentenceEn: The phenomenon happens when thunder and lightning mix with a heavy snowstorm—sometimes causing loud claps that can be confused with explosions.
phenomenon.translationZh: 这种现象发生在雷声和闪电与强烈暴风雪相遇时——有时会产生响亮的爆裂声，可能被误认为是爆炸声。
phenomenon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

phenomenon.sentenceEn: One benefit of this change is that students will not fall victim to the "summer slide," or the well-documented phenomenon where students forget some of the knowledge they have acquired when too much time is taken off from school.
phenomenon.translationZh: 这一变革的好处之一是学生不会成为“暑期滑坡”的受害者，即一个有充分文献记载的现象：当学生休学时间过长时，他们会忘记部分已学知识。
phenomenon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

phenomenon.sentenceEn: The phenomenon of math anxiety is characterized as a general sense of feeling that the subject is hard compared with other subjects leading to a subsequent lack or loss of confidence.
phenomenon.translationZh: 数学焦虑现象的特征是一种普遍感觉，即与其他学科相比，数学这门学科难度较大，进而导致信心不足或丧失。
phenomenon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

phenomenon.sentenceEn: The phenomenon is often referred to as the Matthew effect, inspired by the Bible's wisdom that to those who have, more will be given.
phenomenon.translationZh: 这种现象通常被称为马太效应，其灵感源自《圣经》中的智慧：凡有的，还要加给他。

phenomenon.sentenceEn: There's a good explanation for the phenomenon in the book The Formula: The Universal Laws of Success by Albert Laszlo Barabasi.
phenomenon.translationZh: 阿尔伯特·拉斯洛·巴拉巴西在其著作《公式：成功的普遍法则》中对这一现象做出了很好的解释。

planning.sentenceEn: But there are some links to skills like "decision-making, the ability to anticipate and future planning ," she says.
planning.translationZh: 但她表示，这与某些技能有关，比如“决策能力、预判能力以及未来规划能力”。

planning.sentenceEn: "There are plenty of soft skills that gamers can utilise in a professional setting, such as teamwork, problem solving and strategic planning ," says Ryan Gardner, a regional director with Hays recruitment.
planning.translationZh: 海斯招聘公司的区域总监瑞安·加德纳表示：“玩家可以将许多软技能运用到职场中，例如团队合作、问题解决能力以及战略规划。”

planning.sentenceEn: There is the planning of the ceremony itself, the merging(合并) of two households and all of the details involved in that.
planning.translationZh: 这包括婚礼本身的策划、两个家庭的合并，以及所有相关的细节。

planning.sentenceEn: On the contrary, taking risks in entrepreneurship involves careful planning and hard work.
planning.translationZh: 相反，创业中的风险承担需要周密的规划和辛勤的付出。
planning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

planning.sentenceEn: Some parts of the world have seen successful implementation of family planning .
planning.translationZh: 世界上一些地区的计划生育工作已成功实施。

planning.sentenceEn: They combine clock-based and task-based planning .
planning.translationZh: 他们结合了基于时间和基于任务的规划方式。

plus.sentenceEn: Plus , she adds, it's not an ideal way to reach the advised 'five a day'.
plus.translationZh: 此外，她补充道，这并非达到建议的"每日五份蔬果"的理想方式。

plus.sentenceEn: Meatless meats are generally a healthier choice than beef because they are cholesterol-free, plus they're a good source of vitamins, minerals, protein, and fiber.
plus.translationZh: 素肉通常比牛肉更健康，因为它们不含胆固醇，而且是维生素、矿物质、蛋白质和纤维的良好来源。
plus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

plus.sentenceEn: Plus , streets redesigned for bikes and pedestrians tend to become more pleasant places to hang around, so "in a lot of cases, that's created much nicer environments that are really good for those businesses."
plus.translationZh: 此外，重新设计并适配自行车和行人的街道往往会变得更宜人，更适合逗留，因此“在很多情况下，这创造了更好的环境，对这些商家大有裨益”。

plus.sentenceEn: He goes to the gym most days, plus tennis two or three times a week.
plus.translationZh: 他大多数日子都会去健身房，另外每周还打两三次网球。
plus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第3句

plus.sentenceEn: Plus , it requires two people, which works out more expensive.
plus.translationZh: 而且，这需要两个人来做，所以费用也会更高。
plus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第4句

presence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

presence.sentenceEn: This research found college students were more likely to choose healthy food in the presence of an observer of a different race, as opposed to an observer from their own race.
presence.translationZh: 这项研究发现，与面对同种族观察者相比，大学生在面对不同种族观察者时更有可能选择健康食品。
presence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

presence.sentenceEn: However, this number was 31 percent when in the presence of an unknown student from another university.
presence.translationZh: 然而，当有来自其他大学的陌生学生在场时，这一比例上升到了31%。
presence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

presence.sentenceEn: They still make their presence felt.
presence.translationZh: 他们的存在感依然很强。

processed.sentenceEn: Most imitation meats are highly processed and contain high amounts of sodium(钠) compared to traditional beef.
processed.translationZh: 大多数人造肉属于高度加工食品，与传统牛肉相比钠含量也更高。
processed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

processed.sentenceEn: They're nutritious, inexpensive, and far more sustainable than any of the processed meatless substitutes on the market today.
processed.translationZh: 它们营养丰富、价格实惠，而且比当今市场上任何加工肉类替代品都要可持续得多。
processed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

processed.sentenceEn: Afterwards, the participants read a fictional survey of teens who wanted to "fight back against the companies by buying and eating less processed food"
processed.translationZh: 随后，参与者阅读了一项虚构的青少年调查，这些青少年希望通过减少购买和食用加工食品来“反击那些大公司”。
processed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

processed.sentenceEn: In short, natural flavors are extracted from plants and animals to create specific flavors for processed foods.
processed.translationZh: 简而言之，天然香料是从动植物中提取的，用于为加工食品创造特定的风味。
processed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

processed.sentenceEn: There have been half-hearted but well-publicized efforts by some food companies to reduce calories in their processed foods, but the Standard American Diet is still the polar opposite of the healthy, mostly plant-based diet that just about every expert says we should be eating.
processed.translationZh: 一些食品公司确实做出了些三心二意却又大肆宣传的努力，试图减少其加工食品中的卡路里含量，但标准美式饮食与几乎所有专家都建议我们应该采用的健康、以植物为主的饮食方式仍然截然不同。

processed.sentenceEn: Why do so many Americans eat tons of processed food, the stuff that is correctly called junk(垃圾) and should really carry warning labels?
processed.translationZh: 为什么这么多美国人吃大量加工食品——那些被准确称为垃圾食品、真的应该贴警告标签的东西？

proverb.sentenceEn: Many proverbs remind people of the values that are important in the culture.
proverb.translationZh: 许多谚语使人们想起在该文化中重要的价值观。
proverb.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

proverb.sentenceEn: Benjamin Franklin, a famous American diplomat, writer and scientist, died in 1790, but his proverb "Time is money" is taken more seriously by Americans of today than ever before.
proverb.translationZh: 美国著名外交家、作家和科学家本杰明·富兰克林于1790年去世，但他的谚语"时间就是金钱"在今天的美国人中受到了前所未有的重视。
proverb.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

proverb.sentenceEn: For example, Americans today do not pay much attention to the proverb "Haste makes waste", because patience is not important to them.
proverb.translationZh: 例如，如今的美国人不太在意“欲速则不达”这句谚语，因为耐心对他们而言并不重要。
proverb.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句
文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

proverb.sentenceEn: Some proverbs are assuming more and more importance.
proverb.translationZh: 有些谚语则变得越来越重要。

psychology.sentenceEn: The concept has been applied to a wide range of disciplines, from developmental psychology to economics and engineering.
psychology.translationZh: 这一概念已被广泛应用于多个学科领域，从发展心理学到经济学和工程学。
psychology.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

psychology.sentenceEn: While genes can encourage an interest in doing new things, a 2012 study in the journal Psychology and Aging found completing reasoning tasks like puzzles and number games can enhance that desire for novel experiences, which can, in turn, refresh the brain.
psychology.translationZh: 虽然基因可能会激发人们尝试新事物的兴趣，但2012年发表在《心理学与老龄化》期刊上的一项研究发现，完成拼图和数字游戏等推理任务可以增强这种对新奇体验的渴望，进而让大脑焕然一新。
psychology.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

psychology.sentenceEn: In social psychology , the term "person perception" refers to the mental processes that we use to form impressions of other people.
psychology.translationZh: 在社会心理学中，“人际知觉”一词指的是我们用于形成对他人印象的心理过程。
psychology.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

psychology.sentenceEn: A study led by Yale Professor of Psychology , Paul O'Keefe, found that having a growth mindset(思维倾向) of interest may spark this type of innovation.
psychology.translationZh: 耶鲁大学心理学教授保罗·奥基夫领导的一项研究发现，拥有兴趣成长型思维倾向可能会激发这类创新。
psychology.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

psychology.sentenceEn: As Professor O'Keefe pointed out, "This research provides a useful direction for organizations whose products and services call for integrated and creative solutions. Take smartphones for example. You need not only computer science and engineering knowledge, but also an understanding of psychology and visual design to create a better product. Employees with a growth mindset may be more likely to devise innovative ideas that bridge multiple areas of knowledge to achieve better solutions."
psychology.translationZh: 正如奥基夫教授所指出的：“这项研究为那些其产品和服务需要综合创新解决方案的组织提供了有益的方向。以智能手机为例，要创造出更好的产品，不仅需要计算机科学和工程知识，还需要对心理学和视觉设计有所了解。拥有成长型思维倾向的员工更有可能提出跨多个知识领域的创新想法，从而实现更好的解决方案。”
psychology.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

psychology.sentenceEn: What is the finding of the 2012 study in the journal Psychology and Aging?
psychology.translationZh: 2012年发表在《心理学与衰老》期刊上的研究有什么发现？

panic.sentenceEn: The price of school uniforms can spark panic among families struggling with the high cost of living.
panic.translationZh: 校服的价格可能会让那些在高昂生活成本中挣扎的家庭感到恐慌。
panic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

panic.sentenceEn: "It was like a split second of panic …that resulted in this nervous reaction on the plane," said passenger Brian Healy.
panic.translationZh: 乘客布莱恩·希利说：“那一瞬间我感到一阵恐慌，导致我在飞机上做出了这种紧张反应。”
panic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

panic.sentenceEn: So if you have a disagreement with a securely attached person, they're not going to panic .
panic.translationZh: 所以，如果你与一个拥有安全型依恋风格的人发生分歧，他们不会惊慌失措。
panic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第2句

panic.sentenceEn: New technologies always provoke generational panic , which usually has more to do with adult fears than with the lives of teenagers.
panic.translationZh: 新技术总会引发代际恐慌，而这种恐慌往往更多地与成年人的担忧有关，而非青少年的生活本身。

panic.sentenceEn: Fears over screen-based technology represent the most recent panic in response to technological change.
panic.translationZh: 对屏幕技术的担忧是针对技术变革的最新一轮恐慌。
panic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

panic.sentenceEn: They are spreading panic in the soda industry.
panic.translationZh: 它们正在苏打饮料行业引发恐慌。

passive.sentenceEn: Let's consider a couple more reasons to prioritize active practice over passive learning.
passive.translationZh: 让我们再考虑几个为什么要优先选择主动练习而非被动学习的理由。

passive.sentenceEn: Passive learning is not a form of practice because although you gain new knowledge, you are not discovering how to apply that knowledge.
passive.translationZh: 被动学习并非一种练习形式，因为尽管你获得了新知识，却并未探索如何应用这些知识。

passive.sentenceEn: First, passive learning can be a stick that supports inaction.
passive.translationZh: 首先，被动学习可能会成为支持不作为的拐杖。

passive.sentenceEn: Passive inspiration can give you ideas, but active inspiration will give you power.
passive.translationZh: 被动启发能为你带来想法，但主动启发会赋予你力量。
passive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

passive.sentenceEn: Every time you read an article or listen to an interview, you're practicing passive inspiration.
passive.translationZh: 每当你阅读一篇文章或收听一次访谈时，你都是在进行被动式启发。
passive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

passive.sentenceEn: What does the passage say passive inspiration can do?
passive.translationZh: 文章认为被动灵感能起到什么作用？

peak.sentenceEn: Three Michelin stars is the highest award, given to chefs who are at the peak of their profession.
peak.translationZh: 米其林三星是最高奖项，颁发给那些处于职业生涯巅峰的厨师。
peak.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

peak.sentenceEn: "When people book their holidays they get so emotionally involved, and when they find that villa at a good price with availability in peak season, they are an easy target," says Cooper.
peak.translationZh: 库珀说：“人们预订假期时往往情感投入很深，当他们发现一栋价格优惠且在旺季有空房的别墅时，就很容易成为诈骗目标。”

peak.sentenceEn: This type of arrangement peaked around 1960, when 62% of the nation's 18- to 34-year-olds were living with a spouse or partner in their own household, and only one-in-five were living with their parents.
peak.translationZh: 这种居住方式在1960年左右达到顶峰，当时美国62%的18至34岁年轻人与配偶或伴侣同住一个独立家庭，而仅有五分之一的人与父母同住。

peak.sentenceEn: This arrangement peaked around 1940, when about 35% of the nation's 18- to 34-year-olds lived with mom and/or dad (compared with 32% in 2014).
peak.translationZh: 这种居住方式在1940年左右达到顶峰，当时美国约35%的18至34岁年轻人与父母同住（相比之下，2014年这一比例为32%）。

peak.sentenceEn: The share of young men with jobs peaked around 1960 at 84%.
peak.translationZh: 年轻男性的就业率在1960年左右达到峰值，为84%。

peak.sentenceEn: He had already passed the peak of his racing life.
peak.translationZh: 他已过了赛马生涯的巅峰期。

pediatrician.sentenceEn: But UCLA pediatrician Carlos Lerner acknowledged that the pediatricians ' new prescription may meet with skepticism(怀疑) from parents, who are anxious for advice on how to give their kids a leg up in the world.
pediatrician.translationZh: 但加州大学洛杉矶分校的儿科医生卡洛斯·勒纳承认，儿科医生们的新"处方"可能会遭到家长的怀疑，他们迫切希望获得如何让孩子在世界上领先一步的建议。

pediatrician.sentenceEn: "This may seem old-fashioned, but there are skills to be learned when kids aren't told what to do," said Dr. Michael Yogman, a Harvard Medical School pediatrician who led the drafting of the call to arms.
pediatrician.translationZh: 哈佛医学院儿科医生迈克尔·约格曼博士是这份行动倡议的主要起草人，他表示：“这看似有些过时，但当孩子们无需按指令行事时，他们能学到许多技能。”

pediatrician.sentenceEn: The pediatricians insist that it's not.
pediatrician.translationZh: 但儿科医生们坚称事实并非如此。

pediatrician.sentenceEn: Pediatricians aren't the only ones who have noticed.
pediatrician.translationZh: 注意到这一现象的并非只有儿科医生。

pediatrician.sentenceEn: In the pediatricians ' view, essentially every life skill that's valued in adults can be built up with play.
pediatrician.translationZh: 儿科医生们认为，成年人身上所有受重视的生活技能基本上都能通过玩耍培养起来。

pediatrician.sentenceEn: Playing with digital devices discourages kids from active discovery, according to pediatrician Dr. Michael Yogman.
pediatrician.translationZh: 儿科医生迈克尔·约格曼博士表示，玩数字设备会阻碍孩子主动探索发现。

perfection.sentenceEn: Grit is different because it tells us that perfection isn't the goal.
perfection.translationZh: 坚韧的不同之处在于，它告诉我们完美并非目标。
perfection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

perfection.sentenceEn: But if gravity is removed, the beans float around in a heated oven, receiving 360 degrees of evenly distributed heat and roast to near perfection .
perfection.translationZh: 但如果去除重力，咖啡豆会在加热的容器中漂浮，接受360度均匀分布的热量，烤至近乎完美。
perfection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

perfection.sentenceEn: M: Yes, but I have this urge to strive for perfection .
perfection.translationZh: 男：是的，但我总是渴望追求完美。
perfection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

perfection.sentenceEn: Of course, I had heard that genius could show itself at an early age, so I was only slightly taken aback that I had achieved perfection at the tender age of 14.
perfection.translationZh: 当然，我曾听说过天才早慧的说法，所以对于自己在14岁这样稚嫩的年纪就达到了完美，我只是略感惊讶而已。

perfection.sentenceEn: A writer should polish his writing repeatedly so as to get closer to perfection .
perfection.translationZh: 作家应反复打磨自己的作品，以臻于完美。

perfection.sentenceEn: They are burdened by their expectation of perfection .
perfection.translationZh: 他们被追求完美的期望所困扰。

phase.sentenceEn: It shouldn't be just a one-day event but a course integrated throughout the whole of high school that would allow students to gradually expand their financial literacy, and would prevent the need for a 'catch up' phase once we're out on our own after graduation.
phase.translationZh: 这不应只是一个单日活动，而应是一门贯穿整个高中阶段的课程，让学生能够逐步提升金融素养，并避免我们毕业后独立生活时还需要一个'追赶'阶段。
phase.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

phase.sentenceEn: He encourages residents to think of their age as an enriching new phase of life rather than the end of it.
phase.translationZh: 他鼓励老人们将自己的年龄视为人生中一个充实的新阶段，而非生命的终点。
phase.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

phase.sentenceEn: Byun Young-Jin chairs the Songdo real estate association and started selling property here when the first phase of the city opened in 2005.
phase.translationZh: Byun Young-Jin是松岛房地产协会的主席，他从2005年该城市第一期项目启动时就开始在这里销售房产。

phase.sentenceEn: This is because fifth generation networks are still in testing and trial phases .
phase.translationZh: 这是因为第五代网络仍处于测试和试验阶段。
phase.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第9句

phase.sentenceEn: That feeling echoes the beliefs of the Therapeutic Food Pantry program at Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital, which completed its pilot phase and is about to expand on an ongoing basis to five clinic sites throughout the city.
phase.translationZh: 这种理念与扎克伯格旧金山综合医院的“治疗性食品储藏室”项目的理念不谋而合。该项目已完成试点阶段，即将在全市范围内持续扩展至五个诊所站点。

phase.sentenceEn: It can be a new phase of one's life.
phase.translationZh: 这可能是人生的一个新阶段。

philosopher.sentenceEn: One American philosopher stated that addressing the needs of the poor and vulnerable is about more than money—it is mostly about creating conditions under which prosperity and opportunity can thrive.
philosopher.translationZh: 一位美国哲学家指出，满足贫困和弱势群体的需求不仅仅关乎金钱——更重要的是创造能够让繁荣与机遇蓬勃发展的条件。
philosopher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

philosopher.sentenceEn: The maker philosophy echoes old ideas advocated by John Dewey, Montessori, and even ancient Greek philosophers , as we pointed out recently.
philosopher.translationZh: 正如我们最近指出的那样，创客理念呼应了约翰·杜威、蒙台梭利，甚至古希腊哲学家所倡导的古老思想。

philosopher.sentenceEn: "While we teach, we learn," said Roman philosopher Seneca.
philosopher.translationZh: 罗马哲学家塞涅卡曾说：“教学相长。”
philosopher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

philosopher.sentenceEn: The wisdom of the ancient Greek philosophers is timeless, says Soupios.
philosopher.translationZh: 苏皮奥斯说，古希腊哲学家的智慧是永恒的。

philosopher.sentenceEn: The answer is yes, according to a new book The 10 Golden Rules: Ancient Wisdom from the Greek Philosophers on Living a Good Life.
philosopher.translationZh: 根据新书《十大黄金法则：古希腊哲人的美好生活智慧》，答案是肯定的。

philosopher.sentenceEn: Ancient philosophers strongly advise that we do good.
philosopher.translationZh: 古代哲学家极力主张我们行善。

politician.sentenceEn: And then, for the last 10 years, I've worked as a political consultant, advising politicians at the national level about problems in our country.
politician.translationZh: 然后，在过去的10年里，我一直担任政治顾问，为国家级别的政治人物就国家问题提供建议。
politician.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

politician.sentenceEn: They are also more likely to attend university and become professional athletes, chief executives and even important politicians .
politician.translationZh: 他们也更有可能上大学，并成为职业运动员、首席执行官，甚至重要的政界人士。
politician.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

politician.sentenceEn: Politicians , policymakers, commissioners and school leaders must be brave enough to make the leap towards reimagining schools as providers of health as well as education services.
politician.translationZh: 政治家、政策制定者、部门主管和学校领导必须有足够的勇气迈出这一步，将学校重新构想为既能提供教育服务又能提供健康服务的机构。
politician.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

politician.sentenceEn: During the following decades, some industrialists and politicians launched a campaign to sow doubt in the minds of the American public about the ability of fossil-fuel use, deforestation and other human activities to influence the planet's climate.
politician.translationZh: 在接下来的几十年里，一些工业家和政治家发起了一场运动，旨在让美国公众对使用化石燃料、毁林和其他人类活动影响地球气候的能力产生怀疑。
politician.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

politician.sentenceEn: Why did politicians use the two terms "global warming" and "climate change"?
politician.translationZh: 为什么政客们使用“全球变暖”和“气候变化”这两个术语？

politician.sentenceEn: The raccoon became as famous as some politicians .
politician.translationZh: 这只浣熊变得和一些政客一样出名。

poll.sentenceEn: This is confirmed by a recent poll that found that, for half of hourly workers, their top concern is not that they work too much but that they work too little.
poll.translationZh: 最近的一项民意调查证实了这一点，该调查发现，对于一半的小时工来说，他们最关心的不是工作太多，而是工作太少。

poll.sentenceEn: A recent Harris poll revealed that 79% of Americans say they enjoy cooking and 30% "love it"; 14% admit to not enjoying kitchen work and just 7% won't go near the stove at all.
poll.translationZh: 哈里斯互动公司最近的一项民意调查显示，79%的美国人表示他们喜欢烹饪，30%的人“热爱烹饪”；14%的人承认不喜欢厨房工作，仅有7%的人完全不碰炉灶。

poll.sentenceEn: For example, the language and polls expert Frank Luntz wrote a memo encouraging the use of "climate change" because the phrase sounded less scary than "global warming," reported the Guardian.
poll.translationZh: 例如，《卫报》报道，语言和民意调查专家弗兰克·伦茨曾撰写备忘录，鼓励使用“气候变化”一词，因为这个短语听起来没有“全球变暖”那么吓人。
poll.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

poll.sentenceEn: The most recent National Journal poll asked respondents about the American dream, what it takes to achieve their goals, and whether or not they felt a significant amount of control over their ability to be successful.
poll.translationZh: 《国家期刊》最新民调询问受访者对美国梦的看法、实现目标需要付出什么，以及他们对自己获得成功的能力是否有较强的掌控感。
poll.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

poll.sentenceEn: Waiters, keen observers of humanity that they are, are catching on to this; in one poll , a full 30% said they didn't believe the job they did had any impact on the tips they received.
poll.translationZh: 服务员们是洞察人性的敏锐观察者，他们渐渐明白了这一点；在一项调查中，足足有30%的服务员表示，他们认为自己的工作表现对所获得的小费没有任何影响。
poll.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

poll.sentenceEn: What is the finding of the latest National Journal poll concerning the American dream?
poll.translationZh: 《国家杂志》最新民意调查关于美国梦的发现是什么？

practical.sentenceEn: Put in practical terms, when thinking of yourself in a month or a year or a decade, your brain registers that person in ways similar to how it would register Taylor Swift or the mailman.

principal.translationZh: 美国教育部长阿恩·邓肯表示：“所有儿童，无论其种族、居住地区或家庭收入如何，都有权获得高质量的教育。为教师和校长提供帮助学生充分发挥潜力所需的支持，这一点至关重要。”
principal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

principal.sentenceEn: Why did the school principal ask what needed to change?
principal.translationZh: 校长为什么问需要做出哪些改变？

prior.sentenceEn: Prior research on negative reciprocity among workers found that it can result in lower employee motivation, business performance and workplace morale(士气) and culture.
prior.translationZh: 先前关于员工间消极互惠行为的研究发现，这种行为会导致员工积极性、企业绩效以及职场士气和文化的降低。
prior.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

prior.sentenceEn: This idea is supported by plenty of prior research.
prior.translationZh: 这一观点得到了大量先前研究的支持。
prior.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

prior.sentenceEn: Prior to being spoon-fed number words, children can only approximately discriminate quantities beyond three.
prior.translationZh: 在被灌输数字词汇之前，儿童只能大致辨别超过三的数量。

prior.sentenceEn: Technical engineers who worked on the plane prior to take-off are reportedly going to be questioned by the police.
prior.translationZh: 据报道，起飞前对该飞机进行过维修的技术工程师将接受警方讯问。
prior.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

prior.sentenceEn: Prior to beginning his design, the architect spent some time in the client's old home, observing their life and studying their habits.
prior.translationZh: 在开始设计之前，这位建筑师在客户的老宅中待了一段时间，观察他们的生活，研究他们的习惯。
prior.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

prior.sentenceEn: Absorbing new information is helpful in making better decisions prior to action.
prior.translationZh: 吸收新信息有助于在行动前做出更好的决策。

privacy.sentenceEn: We just have more space and privacy .
privacy.translationZh: 我们只是有更多的空间和隐私。
privacy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第4句

privacy.sentenceEn: The American Civil Liberties Union has stated that digital assistants create a threat to privacy from hackers.
privacy.translationZh: 美国公民自由联盟指出，数字助手带来了黑客入侵隐私的威胁。

privacy.sentenceEn: This has already raised privacy concerns.
privacy.translationZh: 这已经引发了隐私方面的担忧。

privacy.sentenceEn: Parents are wrong to worry that kids don't care about privacy .
privacy.translationZh: 家长们担心孩子不重视隐私，这种担忧是错误的。

privacy.sentenceEn: Some people are concerned about privacy because their phones are constantly collecting their personal information.
privacy.translationZh: 有些人担心隐私问题，因为他们的手机在不断收集他们的个人信息。

promising.sentenceEn: Importantly, there were also some promising effects of the new intervention on actual behavior.
promising.translationZh: 更重要的是，这项新干预措施对实际行为也产生了一些积极的影响。
promising.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

promising.sentenceEn: Apparently associating a healthy diet with teenagers' own values seems to be a promising avenue to prevent obesity.
promising.translationZh: 显然，将健康饮食与青少年自身的价值观联系起来，似乎是预防肥胖的一条有效途径。
promising.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第6句

promising.sentenceEn: Now a large-scale study has tried an innovative approach to change teenagers' attitudes towards healthy eating, and the results are promising .
promising.translationZh: 现在，一项大规模研究尝试用一种创新方法来改变青少年对健康饮食的态度，结果非常乐观。
promising.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

promising.sentenceEn: But there are promising students from struggling families across the nation who should not rule out their dream schools entirely.
promising.translationZh: 但是，全国各地仍有许多来自困难家庭的优秀学生，他们不应该完全放弃自己的梦想大学。

promising.sentenceEn: Doesn't a wallet—that time-honoured Friday-night feeling of pleasing, promising fatness—represent something that matters?
promising.translationZh: 钱包——那种由来已久的周五晚上令人愉悦、充满希望的厚实感——难道不代表着某种重要的东西吗？
promising.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

promising.sentenceEn: They do not look promising at the moment.
promising.translationZh: 目前看来，它们的情况并不乐观。

painful.sentenceEn: Yet, there are valid reasons boredom may feel so painful .
painful.translationZh: 然而，无聊感之所以如此令人痛苦，是有其合理原因的。
painful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

painful.sentenceEn: Native to the South Pacific and Indian Ocean, the potentially deadly fish has poisonous hooks and a painful sting capable of killing people.
painful.translationZh: 这种具有潜在致命危险的鱼类原产于南太平洋和印度洋，长有毒钩，其蛰刺疼痛难忍，可致人死亡。
painful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

painful.sentenceEn: Bill, for instance, often gets painful "flashbacks", in which unwanted memories intrude into his consciousness, but overall he has chosen to see it as the best way of avoiding repeating the same mistakes.
painful.translationZh: 例如，比尔经常会经历痛苦的“闪回”——那些不想要的记忆侵入他的意识——但总体而言，他选择将这种能力视为避免重蹈覆辙的最佳方式。

painful.sentenceEn: He said, "My stings are a bit painful , but I'm pleased it all worked out and I could help. People need to realize that bees are valuable and they should be looked after."
painful.translationZh: 他说：“被蜇的地方有点疼，但我很高兴一切都解决了，也很欣慰能帮上忙。人们需要意识到蜜蜂是宝贵的，应该得到保护。”
painful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

painful.sentenceEn: A woman encouraged to try knitting and crocheting after developing an autoimmune disease that caused a lot of hand pain reported on the Craft Yarn Council site that her hands are now less stiff and painful .
painful.translationZh: 一位女性在患上自身免疫性疾病并导致严重手部疼痛后，尝试了编织和钩织。她在Craft Yarn Council网站上分享说，现在她的手不再那么僵硬和疼痛了。

painful.sentenceEn: It frees us from painful memories.
painful.translationZh: 它将我们从痛苦的记忆中解脱出来。

patience.sentenceEn: Building the skills required of a user experience designer takes time, patience , and commitment.
patience.translationZh: 培养一名用户体验设计师所需的技能需要时间、耐心和投入。
patience.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

patience.sentenceEn: None of these explained away the gender gap, so we applied data collected from surveys that express consumer preferences that play a central role in economic decisions, such as patience and risk avoidance.
patience.translationZh: 这些因素都无法解释这种性别差异，因此我们采用了从调查中收集的数据，这些调查反映了在经济决策中起核心作用的消费者偏好，例如耐心程度和风险规避倾向。
patience.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

patience.sentenceEn: They say that kids use overly casual language and text-speak in writing, and don't have as much patience for long reading and complex arguments.
patience.translationZh: 他们说孩子们在写作中使用过于随意的语言和短信式简写，并且对长篇阅读和复杂论述缺乏耐心。

patience.sentenceEn: In fact many experts argue that the most important 21st-century skills aren't related to specific technologies or subject matter, but to creativity; skills like imagination, problem-finding and problem-solving, teamwork, optimism, patience and the ability to experiment and take risks.
patience.translationZh: 事实上，许多专家认为，21世纪最重要的技能与特定技术或学科内容无关，而是与创造力相关；这些技能包括想象力、发现问题与解决问题的能力、团队合作精神、乐观态度、耐心，以及进行实验和承担风险的能力。
patience.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

patience.sentenceEn: Learning from experience is something that takes time and patience .
patience.translationZh: 从经验中学习需要时间和耐心。

patience.sentenceEn: For example, Americans today do not pay much attention to the proverb "Haste makes waste", because patience is not important to them.
patience.translationZh: 例如，如今的美国人不太在意“欲速则不达”这句谚语，因为耐心对他们而言并不重要。
patience.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

pension.sentenceEn: In addition to people being healthier and living much longer, economists say that a combination of financial considerations such as years of slow rise in real wages and a shift away from traditional pensions in the private sector are some of the reasons people delay retirement.
pension.translationZh: 经济学家表示，除了人们身体更健康、寿命更长之外，由于实际工资增长多年停滞，以及私营部门从传统养老金制度转型等经济因素的共同作用，也是导致人们推迟退休的部分原因。
pension.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

pension.sentenceEn: W: I am always talking to my elder daughter about the importance of saving into a pension .
pension.translationZh: 女：我总是跟我的大女儿谈论为养老金储蓄的重要性。
pension.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

pension.sentenceEn: She's just started a part-time job and was thinking of not contributing to her pension .
pension.translationZh: 她刚开始一份兼职工作，正考虑不缴纳养老金。
pension.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第2句

pension.sentenceEn: Understandably, there are concerns about what this means for public finances given the associated health and pension challenges.
pension.translationZh: 可以理解的是，考虑到随之而来的医疗和养老金挑战，人们担心这对公共财政意味着什么。

pension.sentenceEn: Rising life expectancy(预期寿命), combined with the replacement of generous defined-benefit pension plans with less generous defined-contribution ones, means that even the better-off must work longer to have a comfortable retirement.
pension.translationZh: 预期寿命的延长，加上原先慷慨的固定收益养老金计划被不那么慷慨的固定缴费养老金计划所取代，意味着即使是较富裕人群也必须延长工作时间才能安享舒适的退休生活。
pension.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

pension.sentenceEn: More and more people in the workplace find it hard to rely on traditional pensions .
pension.translationZh: 职场中越来越多的人发现，依靠传统的退休金已变得愈发困难。

persistent.sentenceEn: People age 45+ face persistent and rising pressure in the global job market.
persistent.translationZh: 45岁及以上的人群在全球就业市场上面临着持续且日益增长的压力。

persistent.sentenceEn: The United States is facing a housing crisis: Affordable housing is inadequate, while luxury homes abound(充裕), and homelessness remains a persistent problem.
persistent.translationZh: 美国正面临一场住房危机：经济适用房供应不足，而豪华住宅却比比皆是，无家可归问题也一直困扰着社会。
persistent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

persistent.sentenceEn: A 22-year-old Chinese woman who suffered from a persistent cough was shocked to learn that she had a piece of chicken bone lodged in her lung.
persistent.translationZh: 一名22岁的中国女子长期受咳嗽困扰，当得知自己的肺里卡了一块鸡骨头时，她感到十分震惊。
persistent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

persistent.sentenceEn: Just lengthening that second stage of full-time work may secure the financial assets needed for a 100-year life, but such persistent work will inevitably exhaust precious intangible assets such as productive skills, vitality, happiness, and friendship.
persistent.translationZh: 仅仅延长全职工作的第二阶段或许能积累百年人生所需的财务资产，但这种持续不断的工作将不可避免地耗尽宝贵的无形资产，如生产技能、活力、幸福感和友谊。

persistent.sentenceEn: A few months ago, I was down with a terrible cold which ended in a persistent bad cough.
persistent.translationZh: 几个月前，我得了一场重感冒，最后演变成持续不止的剧烈咳嗽。
persistent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

persistent.sentenceEn: We should stay persistent even in face of failures.
persistent.translationZh: 即使面对失败，我们也应该坚持不懈。

phrase.sentenceEn: In one example, the phrase "Send a text to Jason, Clint, Sam, and Lee saying we're having dinner at Silver Cloud restaurant" was interpreted as sending a message to Jason only, containing the text "Clint Sam and Lee saying we're having dinner at Silver Cloud restaurant".
phrase.translationZh: 例如，当用户说“给杰森、克林特、山姆和李发短信，告诉他们我们要在银云餐厅吃晚饭”时，Siri却将其理解为只给杰森发送一条包含“克林特山姆和李说我们要在银云餐厅吃晚饭”文字内容的信息。

phrase.sentenceEn: Phrases like "I have limited access to email" and "I'll respond as soon as I get back" sound like you're being held against your will from working as opposed to making the most of your time off.
phrase.translationZh: 像'我不方便查收邮件'和'我回来后会尽快回复'这样的说法，听起来好像你是身不由己无法工作，而不是在好好享受休息时间。
phrase.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

phrase.sentenceEn: Fraudsters also invest in pay-per-click advertising to feature at the top of search engines when people type in phrases such as "Spanish seaside villas".
phrase.translationZh: 诈骗者还投资于付费点击广告，以便在人们输入诸如“西班牙海滨别墅”等搜索词时，能出现在搜索引擎结果的顶部。

phrase.sentenceEn: For example, the language and polls expert Frank Luntz wrote a memo encouraging the use of "climate change" because the phrase sounded less scary than "global warming," reported the Guardian.
phrase.translationZh: 例如，《卫报》报道，语言和民意调查专家弗兰克·伦茨曾撰写备忘录，鼓励使用“气候变化”一词，因为这个短语听起来没有“全球变暖”那么吓人。
phrase.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

phrase.sentenceEn: The Maker Movement is rediscovering learning by doing, which is Dewey's phrase from 100 years ago.
phrase.translationZh: 创客运动正在重新发掘“从做中学”这一理念，这是杜威在100年前提出的教育主张。

phrase.sentenceEn: What does the author think of the phrase "midlife crisis"?
phrase.translationZh: 作者如何看待“中年危机”这一说法？

possession.sentenceEn: The arrests were in connection with a string of mail thefts from U.S. Postal Service's collection boxes in Marion County and for the possession of a stolen postal key, according to the Department of Justice.
possession.translationZh: 美国司法部表示，这些逮捕行动与马里恩县发生的一系列美国邮政局邮箱盗窃案有关，同时也涉及持有被盗的邮政钥匙。
possession.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

possession.sentenceEn: Jax and Goodman each face up to five years in federal prison in the mail thefts and up to ten years for possession of the postal key.
possession.translationZh: 贾克斯和古德曼因邮件盗窃案在联邦法院各面临最高五年监禁，因持有邮政钥匙则各面临最高十年监禁。
possession.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

possession.sentenceEn: Kelli's letter, a literate update on both her personal and professional life, touched my heart, and especially so when saying that two decades later she still has the course text, "Solutions to Violence," and that "it remains one of my favorite possessions ."
possession.translationZh: 凯莉的来信文辞优美，详述了她的个人生活与职业生涯近况，深深触动了我的心。尤其令我感动的是，二十年后，她依然珍藏着那本课程教材《暴力的解决方案》，并说这本书"仍是我最珍视的物品之一"。

possession.sentenceEn: One store received thousands of bags of used possessions in one day.
possession.translationZh: 有一家商店在一天之内就收到了数千袋二手物品。
possession.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第11句

possession.sentenceEn: A Philippine fisherman was feeling down on his luck when a house fire forced him to clear out his possessions and change locations.
possession.translationZh: 一名菲律宾渔民正郁郁不得志，一场房屋火灾又迫使他不得不清理家当、搬迁住处。
possession.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

possession.sentenceEn: Many of his possessions were stolen.
possession.translationZh: 他的许多财物都被偷走了。

potentially.sentenceEn: Without conflict, we're often stuck in this artificial harmony where people don't express potentially innovative ideas for fear that they may start conflict with others.
potentially.translationZh: 没有冲突，我们往往会陷入一种虚假的和谐中——人们因担心可能引发冲突而不愿表达那些具有潜在创新性的想法。
potentially.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

potentially.sentenceEn: One potentially greener option is liquid hydrogen and oxygen.
potentially.translationZh: 一种可能更环保的选择是液态氢和液态氧。
potentially.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

potentially.sentenceEn: That means less debt and potentially better credit outcomes when they reach the U.S.
potentially.translationZh: 这意味着他们抵达美国时负债更少，信用状况也可能更好。
potentially.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

potentially.sentenceEn: In today's headlines, Scotland's transport minister has warned of potentially extreme weather conditions as heavy snow is forecast across the country later this week.
potentially.translationZh: 在今天的头条新闻中，苏格兰交通大臣警告称，本周晚些时候全国各地将有大雪预报，可能出现极端天气状况。
potentially.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

potentially.sentenceEn: Native to the South Pacific and Indian Ocean, the potentially deadly fish has poisonous hooks and a painful sting capable of killing people.
potentially.translationZh: 这种具有潜在致命危险的鱼类原产于南太平洋和印度洋，长有毒钩，其蛰刺疼痛难忍，可致人死亡。
potentially.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

potentially.sentenceEn: Each of these stages could potentially be different.
potentially.translationZh: 每个阶段都可能各具特色。

precisely.sentenceEn: This can be seen in the median worker's income over this time period, complete with a shift in 1973 that fits in precisely with when the working week stopped shrinking.
precisely.translationZh: 这一点可以从这段时期工人的收入中位数看出，其中1973年的变化与工作周停止缩短的时间点恰好吻合。

precisely.sentenceEn: This is precisely why parents still need to set firm boundaries around it, as with any other distraction.
precisely.translationZh: 这正是为什么父母仍然需要像对待其他任何干扰一样，为社交媒体使用设定明确的界限。

precisely.sentenceEn: Without numbers, healthy human adults struggle to precisely distinguish and recall quantities as low as four.
precisely.translationZh: 没有数字，健康的成年人也难以精确区分和记住低至四个的数量。

precisely.sentenceEn: For the bulk of our species' approximately 200,000-year lifespan, we had no means of precisely representing quantities.
precisely.translationZh: 在人类物种约20万年的生命史中，绝大多数时间里我们都没有精确表示数量的方法。

precisely.sentenceEn: Precisely like that, you just go around and run people down.
precisely.translationZh: 就是那样，你就四处转，把人撞倒。

precisely.sentenceEn: Karl Barth described midlife precisely this way.
precisely.translationZh: 卡尔·巴特正是这样描述中年的。
precisely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

prescribe.sentenceEn: When doctors prescribe medicine for people, they rarely consider the best time to take it.
prescribe.translationZh: 医生在为病人开药时，很少会考虑服药的最佳时间。
prescribe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

prescribe.sentenceEn: Simply being in the nearest wood has such health benefits that the Woodland Trust successfully lobbied for it to be prescribed by doctors.
prescribe.translationZh: 仅仅是身处最近的树林中就有如此多的健康益处，以至于英国林地信托基金成功游说将其纳入医生的处方。
prescribe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

prescribe.sentenceEn: In a new clinical report, they are urging doctors to prescribe it liberally to the children in their care.
prescribe.translationZh: 在一份新的临床报告中，他们敦促医生为其接诊的儿童大量“开具”这种“药物”。

prescribe.sentenceEn: The program will offer patients several bags of food prescribed for their condition, along with intensive training in how to cook it.
prescribe.translationZh: 该项目将为患者提供数袋根据其病情开具的食品，并辅以关于如何烹饪这些食品的强化培训。

prescribe.sentenceEn: By prescribing nutritional changes or launching programs such as "Shop with your Doc", they are trying to prevent, limit or even reverse disease by changing what patients eat.
prescribe.translationZh: 通过开出营养调整方案或发起诸如“与医生一起购物”等项目，他们正试图通过改变患者的饮食来预防、限制甚至逆转疾病。

prescribe.sentenceEn: What do doctors do when prescribing medicine for people?
prescribe.translationZh: 医生在为病人开药时都会做些什么？

processing.sentenceEn: He and his team took photos of study participants, and then used image processing to visually age their faces.
processing.translationZh: 他和他的团队为研究参与者拍摄了照片，然后使用图像处理技术对他们的面部进行了视觉上的老化处理。

processing.sentenceEn: My own company, LCP, Liquid Control Products, is a leader in safety from leaks in the field of chemical processing .
